_instructions: Example project context for the consulting profile. Copy to my_project_context.json, edit, then run: babok run --profile consulting --context my_project_context.json
engagement_scope: Diagnose and redesign the order-to-cash operating model across sales administration, warehouse dispatch and invoicing for the domestic B2B channel.
exclusions: No software or system delivery — existing WMS and ERP are described as current-state context only
pain_points: Order-to-cash cycle averages 18 days; competitors quote 10
32% of orders require manual correction before dispatch
Credit-hold decisions take 2–3 days and sit with a single controller
Regional hubs run different dispatch procedures
success_criteria: Steering committee adopts one recommended option by 2026-12-15
